project_title: 3D Hologram Desk Buddy v2.0: Interactive Smart Companion

section_1_circuit_design.description: Circuit schematic and Pepper's Ghost optical assembly of the 3D Hologram Desk Buddy v2.0. Powered by an Arduino UNO R3 from the MakerLAB Upgraded Learning Kit v2, the device uses a 0.96" I2C OLED display (SSD1306) projecting upward/downward onto a 45-degree clear acrylic reflector, alongside an interactive Tilt Ball Switch (Pin 2), Photoresistor LDR (Pin A0), and DHT11 Temp/Humidity module (Pin 4) compactly organized on an extra-small mini breadboard.

section_7_project_description: The 3D Hologram Desk Buddy v2.0 is an interactive desktop companion engineered by Rairolf Rabang and Nicole Margareth Sibal using an Arduino UNO R3 from the MakerLAB Upgraded Learning Kit v2 and an extra-small mini breadboard for a sleek, compact, and aesthetic form factor. By utilizing a 0.96-inch monochrome I2C OLED display (SSD1306) and the optical Pepper's Ghost principle with a 45-degree transparent reflection plate, high-contrast graphics appear to float seamlessly in mid-air with zero visible display frame. The system features: (1) expressive animated companion faces with physical motion reactivity, including an interactive 3-tier progressive anger escalation engine (Single tap: Curious '?'; Second tap within 5s: Little Angry with alive huffing and billowing steam; Third tap within 5s: Super Angry with rage tremors and pulsating anger vein 💢, followed by a calm-down exhale) and triple-tap HUD page switching; (2) a circadian auto-sleep engine that detects room lighting via a photoresistor on Pin A0, gracefully putting the companion into deep sleep with floating 'zZz' holograms when lights are turned off; (3) a live DHT11 environmental climate dashboard reporting ambient Temperature (°C and °F), Relative Humidity (%), and Comfort index; (4) an automatic Real-Time Clock synced with computer compile time; (5) a rotating Quote of the Day stored in Flash PROGMEM; and (6) a custom startup splash screen crediting creators Rairolf Rabang & Nicole Margareth Sibal. Powered portably by a 9V battery with non-blocking timing, the Desk Buddy delivers an entertaining, functional, and futuristic companion for any workspace.
